summary: The FileManagement class handles file uploads, ensuring they are saved in a unique folder with options for anonymizing file names and handling image data. It includes file size validation and JPEG format checks.
purpose: To manage the uploading and saving of files in a web application, with specific handling for anonymizing file names and processing image data.

workflows.name: Handle Uploaded File
steps: Check if file is posted and has content.
Perform JPEG format validation if imgData is true.
Construct a new file name, optionally anonymizing it.
Create a new folder using a GUID.
Save the file to the new folder.
Set the full file name and return its relative URL.
Store image binary data if imgData is true.

business_rules: Files exceeding MAX_FILE_SIZE cannot be uploaded.
Anonymize file names if the anonymize flag is true.
JPEG files must not be in 32bpp CMYK format.
calculations: Generate unique file folder using GUID.
Append current date and time to anonymized file names.
system_behavior: Save file in the specified location.
Return file URL relative to the application base folder.
